title: AP Product Preview - Accessibility Test Plan (WCAG 2.1 AA)
overview: Comprehensive accessibility test plan for AP Product Preview feature covering WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for preview mode, catalog card display, full product details page, media verification, specifications, accessibility compliance indicators, and edit options.

testCases.title: Verify View Product button keyboard accessibility
testCases.componentElement: Preview Mode Access - View Product Button
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as AP and has products in Product Management page
steps: 2. Tab to View Product button in actions column
3. Verify focus indicator visible with 3:1 contrast
expectedResults: Accessible name is 'View Product' or similar
Button activates with Enter and Space keys
Preview opens in same or new window/modal
testCases.postconditions: Preview mode is open and accessible

testCases.title: Verify screen reader announces View Product button
testCases.componentElement: Preview Mode Access - View Product Button
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as AP with screen reader enabled
steps: 4. Verify button name and role announced
testCases.postconditions: Screen reader correctly announces button information

testCases.title: Verify preview mode page title and landmarks
testCases.preconditions: User has opened preview mode for a product
steps: 3. Use screen reader to navigate by landmarks
expectedResults: Page title includes 'Preview' and product name
Skip to main content link present
testCases.postconditions: Page structure is properly defined with landmarks

testCases.title: Verify catalog card keyboard navigation
testCases.preconditions: Preview mode is open showing catalog card view
steps: 1. Open preview mode showing catalog card
3. Verify product name is focusable if interactive
expectedResults: Non-interactive elements not in tab order
testCases.postconditions: All card elements are keyboard navigable

testCases.title: Verify catalog card screen reader accessibility
testCases.preconditions: Preview mode is open with screen reader enabled
expectedResults: Product name has proper heading level (h2/h3)
Primary image has meaningful alt text
testCases.postconditions: Screen reader announces all card content correctly

testCases.title: Verify catalog card visual accessibility
testCases.preconditions: Preview mode is open showing catalog card
expectedResults: Information not conveyed by color alone (WCAG 1.4.1)
testCases.postconditions: All visual elements meet contrast requirements

testCases.title: Verify primary image accessibility
testCases.preconditions: Preview mode is open with product that has images
expectedResults: Loading state announced to screen readers
Fallback text available if image fails
testCases.postconditions: Image is accessible with meaningful alt text

testCases.title: Verify product details page structure
testCases.preconditions: Product details page view is open
steps: 1. Switch to product details page view
2. Use screen reader to navigate headings
expectedResults: Heading hierarchy follows logical order (h1, h2, h3)
Section headings are h2 (Description, Specifications, etc.)
testCases.postconditions: Page structure follows proper heading hierarchy

testCases.title: Verify product name and category accessibility
testCases.componentElement: Full Product Details Page - Name and Category
expectedResults: Product name is h1 with 4.5:1 contrast
testCases.postconditions: Product name and category are accessible

testCases.title: Verify descriptions accessibility
testCases.preconditions: Product details page is open with descriptions
testCases.postconditions: Descriptions are properly structured and accessible

testCases.title: Verify keyboard navigation through details page
expectedResults: Focus indicator visible on all elements
testCases.postconditions: All elements are keyboard navigable without traps
